text:
jordan_sales: heads-up: HealthSys (enterprise, HIPAA) asking for commit. Mixed workload: interactive chat ~120 rps (~800 tokens avg) + embeddings ~60 rps (batched). Chat SLA p95 <350ms. Want guidance: how many reserved GPUs vs burst credits?

zoe_runtime: short answer: reserve for steady-state, burst for spikes. Qs: are chat+embeddings allowed on same pool or must be isolated? model sizes?

jordan_sales: chat = 70B quantized family, embeddings = 2B. They prefer Dedicated (single-tenant) if pricing ok.

mike_infra: back-of-envelope: 120*800 = 96k tokens/s for chat. embeddings (batched) ~90k tokens/s equiv. total ~186k tokens/s. conservative per A800 ~4k tokens/s on 70B => naive reserve ~47 GPUs. But batching + KV prefix cache reduces load.

san_mlops: recommend reserve ~30 GPUs baseline (60% sustained), allow burst pool + autoscale to max 50. Enforce embeddings batching >=32. Enable KV caching & prompt normalization to cut effective tokens ~20-35%. Fallback: tuned 13B variant if latency breaches.

amy_account: pricing pattern customers accept: 30 reserved GPUs + 20 burst credits with a soft monthly cap on burst spend. I can model cost once perf sim numbers in.

zoe_runtime: ops checklist: quantized kernels (int8/4), fused-attention kernels, token truncation, smaller max_context. Autoscale: min_replicas=30, max_replicas=50, prewarm_slots=4 per AZ, queue_trigger=150. Canary rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100%.

mike_infra: I'll produce AZ spread and eviction-tolerance notes. Prewarm plan: run KV warmup script before business hours. Example: for f in top_prompts.jsonl; do curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/internal/warmup -d @${f}; done

san_mlops: action items: 1) perf sim with 10-min representative trace (need sample) 2) cost estimate for reserve30+burst20 with capped burst 3) autoscale + fallback runbook. I can start perf sim when Jordan uploads trace.

jordan_sales: I'll request a 20k anonymized trace and permission for a short perf run. ETA sample today, perf-run tomorrow. Tagging @zoe_runtime @mike_infra.

deploy-bot: perf job queued by san_mlops  job id lt-2026-03-23-19-10 (queued).

amy_account: I'll draft contractual language for burst cap, overage tiers, and HIPAA/Baa clause.

jordan_sales: great, thanks all. I'll update once customer shares trace. :pray:
